opennyai_summary.decision:
This writ petition has been filed with the following prayers:-
"(A) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari quashing the F.I.R.
dated 22.10.2021 in Case Crime No. 0287 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act and Section 3/4 of Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019, P.S.- Nanauta, District- Saharanpur.
1 (B) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent No. 2 not to arrest the petitioners in Case Crime No. 0287 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act and Section 3/4 of Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019, P.S.- Nanauta, District- Saharanpur."
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Present petition is accordingly dismissed for want of prosecution.
